svg.aria-label: What you get, the plan: a plan.json sheet lists the README's sections one per row, each with its job (how, features, install, use, limits), a word budget bar and a mark for whether it gets a picture. One row lights at a time and a card beside it names that section, its word budget filling up to the limit and whether it has a picture of its own.
svg.text: Each part gets a job and a budget
Some parts get a picture of their own. The rest are read.
